design.decision: Defend hardest against big contracts: when the opponents bid 9, spend your own tricks setting them rather than padding your bid.
design.opponent: Revealed on the first set; opponents with big builds must weigh bidding high against feeding this.
design.rationale: Rewards defense in proportion to the threat, so it hits the leading team's big bids hardest and works against snowballing; it differs from ub-opp-set-contract-mult, which scales with your own contract.
design.draftText: +3 contract multiplier for each trick in the opponents' contract if the opponents miss their contract
design.hooks: New payoff scaling `per: opponentContractTrick` (the size of the opponents' contract), mirroring per contractTrick.
